title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
oneLinerQuestion: Reconstruct a binary tree using its preorder and inorder traversal arrays.
explanation: The first element in preorder gives the root. Finding this root's index in inorder partitions elements into left and right subtrees, enabling recursive reconstruction.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION buildTree(preorder, inorder):
    IF preorder IS EMPTY OR inorder IS EMPTY THEN RETURN NULL
    root = NEW Node(preorder[0])
    mid = INDEX_OF(inorder, preorder[0])
    root.left = buildTree(preorder[1 TO mid+1], inorder[0 TO mid])
    root.right = buildTree(preorder[mid+1 TO END], inorder[mid+1 TO END])
    RETURN root
END FUNCTION
